_note: Unamendable doctrine predating the settlement. Bounds what the Accord may say. The Nexus rarely authors new orders — it points to which dormant chapter of the Mandate now applies, which is why the Chair assumes it is a machine reading from a book. Chapters are numbered because the Nexus cites them by chapter and verse.

clauses._note: Always active. The reason the archive-access article has a ceiling the player cannot see the reason for.

Reads as doctrinal caution about a poisoned world. Is actually the Presidium making sure no Shaft ever walks out and finds the others. The abandoned Shaft in Chapter 3 is what happens when a Shaft breaks this one.

Dormant until the Nexus cites it. A chapter of scripture that has sat unread for generations and then becomes binding on a Tuesday is exactly the shape of the Chapter 2 pressure: the text has not changed, so why does its meaning keep arriving when it is needed?
Pairs with the fc-founder-stores-unaudited clause. Belt and braces: the Presidium wrote the exemption into both the local law and the doctrine above it.
